items.brief:
Lumenfield (fictional) is a subscription software company selling scheduling tools to clinics. This quarter's review focuses on retention. Our monthly churn rate rose from 1.8% to 2.4% after the price change, and the leadership team wants it back under 2% by year end.

Enterprise deals now depend on security. The Henley Health contract will not be signed until we hand over our SOC 2 report, and the auditors are due on site in March.

Finance tracks growth through annual recurring revenue (ARR), currently 14.2 million, and net revenue retention (NRR), which stood at 108% last quarter because existing customers upgraded their plans.
items.utterance: Our biggest worry this quarter is the... the percentage of customers who leave each month

items.brief:
Harbourview Logistics (fictional) finance review, year end. The new routing platform was capitalised at 2.5 million and will be written off through amortisation over five years, starting in January.

The board focuses on EBITDA rather than net profit, since the depreciation charge distorts the picture this year. Working capital is tight because several customers pay on 90-day terms.

Annual contracts are invoiced up front, so most of that cash sits on the balance sheet as deferred revenue until the service has been delivered.
items.utterance: We spread the cost of the platform over five years, that's the... the accounting word for it

items.brief:
Project Kestrel (fictional) is the migration of the booking service to the new cloud platform, scheduled for the second weekend of May. The target is an uptime SLA of 99.9% throughout the cutover.

We will use a blue-green deployment: the new environment is built next to the live one, tested, and traffic is switched over in a single step. Anything not yet ready ships behind a feature flag and is turned on for a small group of users first.

If error rates rise above 2% in the first hour, the on-call engineer follows the rollback plan and switches traffic back to the old environment.
items.utterance: We'll switch the traffic across using the... two identical environments, one live and one waiting
